audit_items.proof_trace: `deposit_ctoken` (L90-92) guards every deposit with `is_supporting_collateral`; on first deposit this is false, triggering `support_collateral_token` which atomically initializes `coin_types`, `balances`, and `ctoken_values`. The only production caller of `join_ctoken` is `deposit_ctoken` after this guard, and `join_ctoken` itself asserts `coin_types.supports` as a secondary safety check.
